name: B10-0078/2025 (Renew) – Case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Jean-Jacques Wondo, a Belgian-Congolese expert sentenced to death in the Democratic Republic of Congo after a trial it considers unfair. The Parliament condemns the sentence, says the evidence was weak, and calls for his release unless reliable proof of guilt is provided. It also asks Congo to stop carrying out death sentences, to reinstate its ban on the death penalty, and to give Wondo medical care.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests, not a decision.
- **Who it affects:** Wondo, 36 other detainees sentenced to death, and Congo's authorities.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament asks EU institutions to press Congo on human rights and fair trials.
